### 0. Settings

```{r}
#| label: packages

# install.packages(c("bootUR", "vars", "car", "lpirfs"))

library(bootUR)
library(vars)
library(car)
library(lpirfs)

# Dataset
input_csv <- "case2_macro_proxies.csv"

# Global settings
set.seed(123)
alpha <- 0.05
variables <- c("IP", "CPI", "FFR")
proxy_vars <- c("MP1", variables)
irf_horizon <- 48
bootstrap_reps <- 100
irf_runs <- 100
irf_ci <- 0.95
```

# Part I

### 1. Data preparation

```{r}
#| label: data-import

raw <- read.csv(input_csv, check.names = FALSE)

dat <- raw[, c(
  "sasdate",
  "INDPRO",
  "CPIAUCSL",
  "FEDFUNDS"
)]

names(dat)[1] <- "Date"

dat$Date <- as.Date(
  dat$Date,
  format = "%m/%d/%Y"
)

dat <- dat[
  !is.na(dat$Date) &
    dat$Date <= as.Date("2019-12-31"),
]

dat <- dat[order(dat$Date), ]

range(dat$Date)
```

### 2. Series transformation

```{r}
#| label: series-transformations

dat_transformed <- data.frame(
  Date = dat$Date,

  INDPRO = c(
    NA,
    diff(log(dat$INDPRO))
  ),

  CPIAUCSL = c(
    NA,
    NA,
    diff(
      log(dat$CPIAUCSL),
      differences = 2
    )
  ),

  FEDFUNDS = c(
    NA,
    diff(dat$FEDFUNDS)
  )
)

# Common sample after differencing for initial specification starts in March 1959
dat_common <- dat[-c(1, 2), ]

dat_transformed <- dat_transformed[
  -c(1, 2),
]

common_start <- c(
  as.integer(
    format(dat_common$Date[1], "%Y")
  ),
  as.integer(
    format(dat_common$Date[1], "%m")
  )
)

# Original series
levels_ts <- ts(
  dat_common[, c(
    "INDPRO",
    "CPIAUCSL",
    "FEDFUNDS"
  )],
  start = common_start,
  frequency = 12
)

# Common sample series
transformed_ts <- ts(
  dat_transformed[, c(
    "INDPRO",
    "CPIAUCSL",
    "FEDFUNDS"
  )],
  start = common_start,
  frequency = 12
)

range(dat_transformed$Date)
```

### 5. Unit root testing

```{r}
#| label: unit-root-tests

# Series for the VAR
IP  <- log(dat$INDPRO)
CPI <- log(dat$CPIAUCSL)
FFR <- dat$FEDFUNDS


# Trend specification

IP_trend <- order_integration(
  IP,
  method = "boot_adf",
  deterministics = "trend",
  B = bootstrap_reps
)

CPI_trend <- order_integration(
  CPI,
  method = "boot_adf",
  deterministics = "trend",
  B = bootstrap_reps
)

FFR_trend <- order_integration(
  FFR,
  method = "boot_adf",
  deterministics = "trend",
  B = bootstrap_reps
)

trend_orders <- c(
  IP  = unname(IP_trend$order_int),
  CPI = unname(CPI_trend$order_int),
  FFR = unname(FFR_trend$order_int)
)


# Intercept specification

IP_intercept <- order_integration(
  IP,
  method = "boot_adf",
  deterministics = "intercept",
  B = bootstrap_reps
)

CPI_intercept <- order_integration(
  CPI,
  method = "boot_adf",
  deterministics = "intercept",
  B = bootstrap_reps
)

FFR_intercept <- order_integration(
  FFR,
  method = "boot_adf",
  deterministics = "intercept",
  B = bootstrap_reps
)


intercept_orders <- c(
  IP  = unname(IP_intercept$order_int),
  CPI = unname(CPI_intercept$order_int),
  FFR = unname(FFR_intercept$order_int)
)


# Compare deterministic specifications

unit_root_table <- data.frame(
  Series = c(
    "IP",
    "CPI",
    "FFR"
  ),

  Trend = as.integer(
    trend_orders
  ),

  Intercept = as.integer(
    intercept_orders
  ),

  Different = (
    trend_orders != intercept_orders
  )
)

unit_root_table


# Manual unit roots with boot_adf()

urip1 <- boot_adf(diff(diff(IP)), deterministics = "intercept", B = bootstrap_reps)
urip2 <- boot_adf(diff(IP), deterministics = "intercept", B = bootstrap_reps)
urip3 <- boot_adf(IP, deterministics = "trend", B = bootstrap_reps)

urcpi1 <- boot_adf(diff(diff(CPI)), deterministics = "intercept", B = bootstrap_reps)
urcpi2 <- boot_adf(diff(CPI), deterministics = "intercept", B = bootstrap_reps)
urcpi3 <- boot_adf(CPI, deterministics = "trend", B = bootstrap_reps)

urffr1 <- boot_adf(diff(diff(FFR)), deterministics = "intercept", B = bootstrap_reps)
urffr2 <- boot_adf(diff(FFR), deterministics = "intercept", B = bootstrap_reps)
urffr3 <- boot_adf(FFR, deterministics = "trend", B = bootstrap_reps)

unit_root_table_manual <- data.frame(
  Series = c(
    "IP",
    "CPI",
    "FFR"
  ),
  
  Delta_2_P = c(
    urip1$p.value,
    urcpi1$p.value,
    urffr1$p.value
  ),
  
  Delta_1_P = c(
    urip2$p.value,
    urcpi2$p.value,
    urffr2$p.value
  ),
  
  Delta_0_P = c(
    urip3$p.value,
    urcpi3$p.value,
    urffr3$p.value
  ),
  
  Order = c(
    as.numeric(1),
    as.numeric(1),
    as.numeric(1)
  )
)

unit_root_table_manual
```

### 7. VAR setup

```{r}
#| label: prepare-var-data

Y <- data.frame(
  Date = dat_transformed$Date,
  IP   = dat_transformed$INDPRO,
  CPI  = dat_transformed$CPIAUCSL,
  FFR  = dat_transformed$FEDFUNDS
)

x <- as.matrix(
  Y[, variables, drop = FALSE]
)

stopifnot(
  all(is.finite(x))
)

c(
  observations = nrow(x),
  variables = ncol(x)
)
```

### 8. Lag order selection

```{r}
#| label: select-var-lags

# Two years of monthly lags. 
# Default setting allows only up to 10L, therefore we manually set the threshold higher since the previous specification was constrained.

lag_max <- 24

lag_selection <- VARselect(
  x,
  lag.max = lag_max,
  type = "const"
)

lag_table <- data.frame(
  Criterion = c(
    "AIC",
    "HQ",
    "SC / BIC",
    "FPE"
  ),

  Selected_lag = as.integer(c(
    lag_selection$selection[["AIC(n)"]],
    lag_selection$selection[["HQ(n)"]],
    lag_selection$selection[["SC(n)"]],
    lag_selection$selection[["FPE(n)"]]
  ))
)

p_aic <- as.integer(
  lag_selection$selection[["AIC(n)"]]
)

p_bic <- as.integer(
  lag_selection$selection[["SC(n)"]]
)

# Selected lag orders
lag_table
```

### 9. Estimation VAR models

```{r}
#| label: estimate-var-models

fit_aic <- VAR(
  x,
  p = p_aic,
  type = "const"
)

fit_bic <- VAR(
  x,
  p = p_bic,
  type = "const"
)
```

### 10. VAR stability

```{r}
#| label: var-stability

roots_aic <- roots(
  fit_aic,
  modulus = TRUE
)

roots_bic <- roots(
  fit_bic,
  modulus = TRUE
)

stability_table <- data.frame(
  Specification = c(
    paste0(
      "AIC VAR(",
      p_aic,
      ")"
    ),
    paste0(
      "SC/BIC VAR(",
      p_bic,
      ")"
    )
  ),

# Only display max roots for interpretability
  Max_root = c(
    max(roots_aic),
    max(roots_bic)
  ),

  Stable = c(
    all(roots_aic < 1),
    all(roots_bic < 1)
  )
)

stability_table
```

### 11. Residual diagnostics

```{r}
#| label: var-residual-diagnostics

# Common 2-year residual-autocorrelation horizon
serial_horizon <- 24

stopifnot(
  p_aic < serial_horizon,
  p_bic < serial_horizon
)

run_var_diagnostics <- function(
  fit,
  serial_horizon
) {

  root_moduli <- roots(
    fit,
    modulus = TRUE
  )

  serial_result <- serial.test(
    fit,
    lags.pt = serial_horizon,
    type = "PT.adjusted"
  )

  arch_result <- arch.test(
    fit
  )

  normality_result <- normality.test(
    fit
  )

  list(
    lag = fit$p,

    roots = root_moduli,

    stable = all(
      root_moduli < 1
    ),

    max_root = max(
      root_moduli
    ),

    serial_test = serial_result,

    serial_p = as.numeric(
      serial_result$serial$p.value
    ),

    arch_test = arch_result,

    arch_p = as.numeric(
      arch_result$arch.mul$p.value
    ),

    normality_test = normality_result,

    normality_p = as.numeric(
      normality_result$jb.mul$JB$p.value
    )
  )
}

diag_aic <- run_var_diagnostics(
  fit_aic,
  serial_horizon
)

diag_bic <- run_var_diagnostics(
  fit_bic,
  serial_horizon
)
```

### 12. Diagnostic results

```{r}
#| label: diagnostic-summary

diagnostic_table <- data.frame(
  Criterion = c(
    "AIC",
    "SC / BIC"
  ),

  Selected_lag = c(
    diag_aic$lag,
    diag_bic$lag
  ),

  Stable = c(
    diag_aic$stable,
    diag_bic$stable
  ),

  Max_root = c(
    diag_aic$max_root,
    diag_bic$max_root
  ),

  Serial_p = c(
    diag_aic$serial_p,
    diag_bic$serial_p
  ),

  ARCH_p = c(
    diag_aic$arch_p,
    diag_bic$arch_p
  ),

  Normality_p = c(
    diag_aic$normality_p,
    diag_bic$normality_p
  )
)

diagnostic_table$Serial_correlation <- ifelse(
  diagnostic_table$Serial_p < alpha,
  "Rejected",
  "Not rejected"
)

diagnostic_table$ARCH_effects <- ifelse(
  diagnostic_table$ARCH_p < alpha,
  "Rejected",
  "Not rejected"
)

diagnostic_table$Normality <- ifelse(
  diagnostic_table$Normality_p < alpha,
  "Rejected",
  "Not rejected"
)

diagnostic_table
```

### 13. Granger causality

```{r}
#| label: granger-causality

# Block-Granger-Causality Testing

# CPI and FFR -> IP
gc_IP <- causality(
  fit_aic,
  cause = c("CPI", "FFR")
)$Granger

# IP and FFR -> CPI
gc_CPI <- causality(
  fit_aic,
  cause = c("IP", "FFR")
)$Granger

# IP and CPI -> FFR
gc_FFR <- causality(
  fit_aic,
  cause = c("IP", "CPI")
)$Granger

granger_block_table <- data.frame(
  x = c(
    "CPI + FFR",
    "IP + FFR",
    "IP + CPI"
  ),

  y = c(
    "IP",
    "CPI",
    "FFR"
  ),

  F_statistic = c(
    as.numeric(gc_IP$statistic),
    as.numeric(gc_CPI$statistic),
    as.numeric(gc_FFR$statistic)
  ),

  p_value = c(
    gc_IP$p.value,
    gc_CPI$p.value,
    gc_FFR$p.value
  )
)

granger_block_table$Decision <- ifelse(
  granger_block_table$p_value < alpha,
  "Reject H0",
  "Do not reject H0"
)


# Six (conditional) pairwise tests

test_IP_CPI <- linearHypothesis(
  fit_aic$varresult[["CPI"]],
  paste0(
    "IP.l",
    1:p_aic,
    " = 0"
  )
)

# IP -> FFR

test_IP_FFR <- linearHypothesis(
  fit_aic$varresult[["FFR"]],
  paste0(
    "IP.l",
    1:p_aic,
    " = 0"
  )
)

# CPI -> IP

test_CPI_IP <- linearHypothesis(
  fit_aic$varresult[["IP"]],
  paste0(
    "CPI.l",
    1:p_aic,
    " = 0"
  )
)

# CPI -> FFR

test_CPI_FFR <- linearHypothesis(
  fit_aic$varresult[["FFR"]],
  paste0(
    "CPI.l",
    1:p_aic,
    " = 0"
  )
)

# FFR -> IP

test_FFR_IP <- linearHypothesis(
  fit_aic$varresult[["IP"]],
  paste0(
    "FFR.l",
    1:p_aic,
    " = 0"
  )
)

# FFR -> CPI

test_FFR_CPI <- linearHypothesis(
  fit_aic$varresult[["CPI"]],
  paste0(
    "FFR.l",
    1:p_aic,
    " = 0"
  )
)


# Collect results

granger_pairwise_table <- data.frame(
  x = c(
    "IP",
    "IP",
    "CPI",
    "CPI",
    "FFR",
    "FFR"
  ),

  y = c(
    "CPI",
    "FFR",
    "IP",
    "FFR",
    "IP",
    "CPI"
  ),

  F_statistic = c(
    test_IP_CPI$F[2],
    test_IP_FFR$F[2],
    test_CPI_IP$F[2],
    test_CPI_FFR$F[2],
    test_FFR_IP$F[2],
    test_FFR_CPI$F[2]
  ),

  p_value = c(
    test_IP_CPI$`Pr(>F)`[2],
    test_IP_FFR$`Pr(>F)`[2],
    test_CPI_IP$`Pr(>F)`[2],
    test_CPI_FFR$`Pr(>F)`[2],
    test_FFR_IP$`Pr(>F)`[2],
    test_FFR_CPI$`Pr(>F)`[2]
  )
)

granger_pairwise_table$Decision <- ifelse(
  granger_pairwise_table$p_value < alpha,
  "Reject H0",
  "Do not reject H0"
)


granger_block_table
granger_pairwise_table
```

### 14. IRFs in reduced VAR form

```{r}
#| label: reduced-form-irfs

# Reduced-form IRFs with bootstrap confidence intervals
irf_results <- irf(
  fit_aic,
  impulse = variables,
  response = variables,
  n.ahead = irf_horizon,
  ortho = FALSE,
  boot = TRUE,
  ci = irf_ci,
  runs = irf_runs
)

# Extract IRFs by impulse
irf_ip <- irf_results$irf$IP
irf_cpi <- irf_results$irf$CPI
irf_ffr <- irf_results$irf$FFR

# Recover point-estimate responses in levels
# IP  = diff(log(INDPRO))     -> accumulate once
# CPI = diff2(log(CPIAUCSL))  -> accumulate twice
# FFR = diff(FEDFUNDS)        -> accumulate once

to_levels <- function(irf_matrix) {
  
  data.frame(
    Horizon = 0:(nrow(irf_matrix) - 1),
    
    IP = cumsum(
      irf_matrix[, "IP"]
    ),
    
    CPI = cumsum(
      cumsum(irf_matrix[, "CPI"])
    ),
    
    FFR = cumsum(
      irf_matrix[, "FFR"]
    )
  )
}

# Responses in levels for each impulse
irf_ip_levels <- to_levels(irf_ip)
irf_cpi_levels <- to_levels(irf_cpi)
irf_ffr_levels <- to_levels(irf_ffr)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure-reduced-form-irfs

impulses <- c("IP", "CPI", "FFR")
responses <- c("IP", "CPI", "FFR")

par(
  mfrow = c(3, 3),
  mar = c(1.3, 2.2, 1.2, 0.4),
  oma = c(2.2, 4.2, 2.0, 0.2),
  cex = 0.8
)

for (i in seq_along(impulses)) {
  
  impulse <- impulses[i]
  
  for (j in seq_along(responses)) {
    
    response <- responses[j]
    
    y <- irf_results$irf[[impulse]][, response]
    horizon <- 0:(length(y) - 1)
    
    plot(
      horizon,
      y,
      type = "l",
      ylim = range(c(y, 0)),
      xlab = "",
      ylab = "",
      main = "",
      axes = FALSE,
      lwd = 1.2
    )
    
    abline(
      h = 0,
      lty = 2,
      col = "grey40"
    )
    
    axis(
      1,
      cex.axis = 0.55
    )
    
    axis(
      2,
      cex.axis = 0.55
    )
    
    # Response labels
    if (i == 1) {
      mtext(
        response,
        side = 3,
        line = 0.15,
        font = 2,
        cex = 0.7
      )
    }
  }
}

# Impulse labels
mtext(
  "IP",
  side = 2,
  outer = TRUE,
  at = 5 / 6,
  line = 0.5,
  font = 2,
  cex = 0.7
)

mtext(
  "CPI",

  outer = TRUE,
  at = 3 / 6,
  line = 0.5,

  cex = 0.7
)

mtext(
  "FFR",
```

```{r}
#| label: figure-reduced-form-irfs-ci

#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 7.0
#| fig-height: 5.0
#| fig-align: center

impulses <- c("IP", "CPI", "FFR")
responses <- c("IP", "CPI", "FFR")

par(
  mfrow = c(3, 3),
  mar = c(1.3, 2.2, 1.2, 0.4),
  oma = c(2.2, 4.2, 2.0, 0.2),
  cex = 0.8
)

for (i in seq_along(impulses)) {
  
  impulse <- impulses[i]
  
  for (j in seq_along(responses)) {
    
    response <- responses[j]
    
    point <- irf_results$irf[[impulse]][, response]
    lower <- irf_results$Lower[[impulse]][, response]
    upper <- irf_results$Upper[[impulse]][, response]
    
    horizon <- 0:(length(point) - 1)
    
    plot_range <- range(
      c(lower, upper, point, 0)
    )
    
    # Empty plotting region
    plot(
      horizon,
      point,
      type = "n",
      ylim = plot_range,
      xlab = "",
      ylab = "",
      main = "",
      axes = FALSE
    )
    
    # 95% bootstrap confidence interval
    polygon(
      c(horizon, rev(horizon)),
      c(lower, rev(upper)),
      col = adjustcolor(
        "grey70",
        alpha.f = 0.45
      ),
      border = NA
    )
    
    # Zero line
    abline(
      h = 0,
      lty = 3,
      col = "grey40"
    )
    
    # Point estimate
    lines(
      horizon,
      point,
      lwd = 1.2
    )
    
    axis(
      1,
      cex.axis = 0.55
    )
    
    axis(
      2,
      cex.axis = 0.55
    )
    
    # Response labels
    if (i == 1) {
      mtext(
        response,
        side = 3,
        line = 0.15,
        font = 2,
        cex = 0.7
      )
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
  oma = c(2.2, 4.2, 2.0, 0.2),
  cex = 0.8
)

for (i in seq_along(impulses)) {
  
  impulse <- impulses[i]
  
  for (j in seq_along(responses)) {
    
    response <- responses[j]
    
    y <- level_irfs[[impulse]][[response]]
    horizon <- level_irfs[[impulse]]$Horizon
    
    plot(
      horizon,
      y,
      type = "l",
      ylim = range(c(y, 0)),
      xlab = "",
      ylab = "",
      main = "",
      axes = FALSE,
      lwd = 1.2
    )
    
    abline(
      h = 0,
      lty = 2,
      col = "grey40"
    )
    
    axis(
      1,
      cex.axis = 0.55
    )
    
    axis(
      2,
      cex.axis = 0.55
    )
    
    # Response labels
    if (i == 1) {
      mtext(
        response,
        side = 3,
        line = 0.15,
        font = 2,
        cex = 0.7
      )
    }
  }
}

# Impulse labels
mtext(
  "IP",

  outer = TRUE,
```

# Part II

### 15. Recursive SVAR identification

```{r}
#| label: recursive-svar

# Reuse the OLS VAR and reduced-form IRFs estimated in Part I
irf_svar <- irf(
  fit_aic,
  impulse = variables,
  response = variables,
  n.ahead = irf_horizon,
  ortho = TRUE,
  boot = FALSE
)

svar_levels <- lapply(irf_svar$irf, to_levels)

# Reduced form point estimates remain unchanged
rf_var_levels <- list(
  IP = irf_ip_levels,
  CPI = irf_cpi_levels,
  FFR = irf_ffr_levels
)


rf_matched <- setNames(
  lapply(variables, function(shock) {
    z <- irf_results$irf[[shock]][, variables, drop = FALSE]
    own_impact <- irf_svar$irf[[shock]][1, shock]
    to_levels(z * own_impact)
  }),
  variables
)

# Cholesky impact matrix for the ordering IP-CPI-FFR
P <- sapply(
  variables,
  function(shock) {
    irf_svar$irf[[shock]][1, variables]
  }
)


P
```

### 16. Reduced-form VAR versus recursive SVAR

```{r}
#| label: plot-function
#| include: false

plot_irf_matrix <- function(model_levels, labels, lty) {

  oldpar <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
  on.exit({
    layout(1)
    par(oldpar)
  }, add = TRUE)

  layout(
    matrix(c(1:9, 10, 10, 10), nrow = 4, byrow = TRUE),
    heights = c(1, 1, 1, 0.40)
  )

  par(
    mar = c(1.3, 2.2, 1.2, 0.4),
    oma = c(2.2, 4.2, 2.0, 0.2),
    cex = 0.8
  )

  for (i in seq_along(variables)) {
    impulse <- variables[i]

    for (j in seq_along(variables)) {
      response <- variables[j]
      curves <- lapply(
        model_levels,
        function(m) m[[impulse]][[response]]
      )
      horizon <- model_levels[[1]][[impulse]]$Horizon

      plot(
        horizon, curves[[1]], type = "n",
        ylim = range(c(0, unlist(curves))),
        xlab = "", ylab = "", main = "", axes = FALSE
      )

      abline(h = 0, lty = 3, col = "grey60")
      for (k in seq_along(curves)) {
        lines(
          horizon, curves[[k]],
          lty = lty[k], lwd = 1.2, col = "black"
        )
      }

      axis(1, at = seq(0, irf_horizon, by = 12), cex.axis = 0.55)
      axis(2, cex.axis = 0.55)

      if (i == 1) {
        mtext(
          response, side = 3, line = 0.15,
          font = 2, cex = 0.7
        )
      }
    }
  }

  # Dedicated legend row avoids overlap with the x-axis label.
  par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
  plot.new()
  legend(
    x = 0.5, y = 0.74, xjust = 0.5, yjust = 0.5,
    legend = labels,
    lty = lty, lwd = 1.2, col = "black",
    horiz = TRUE, bty = "n",
    cex = if (length(labels) == 3L) 0.63 else 0.75,
    seg.len = 2.7
  )
  text(0.5, 0.12, "Horizon (months)", cex = 0.75)

  # Adjust row-label coordinates for the legend row.
  row_at <- (c(2.5, 1.5, 0.5) + 0.40) / 3.40
  for (i in seq_along(variables)) {
    mtext(
      variables[i], side = 2, outer = TRUE,
      at = row_at[i], line = 0.5, font = 2, cex = 0.7
    )
  }
  mtext("Response", side = 3, outer = TRUE,
        line = 0.9, font = 2, cex = 0.75)
  mtext("Impulse", side = 2, outer = TRUE,
        line = 2.0, font = 2, cex = 0.75)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: figure-reduced-form-versus-svar
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 7.0
#| fig-height: 5.0
#| fig-align: center

plot_irf_matrix(
  model_levels = list(rf_matched, svar_levels),
  labels = c("Reduced-form VAR", "Recursive SVAR"),
  lty = c(1, 2)
)
```

### 17. Recursive ordering sensitivity

```{r}
#| label: alternative-orderings

# Reorder the predefined macroeconomic variables; retain AIC lags
swap_order <- variables[c(2, 1, 3)]
first_order <- variables[c(3, 1, 2)]

fit_swap <- VAR(
  x[, swap_order, drop = FALSE],
  p = p_aic,
  type = "const"
)

fit_first <- VAR(
  x[, first_order, drop = FALSE],
  p = p_aic,
  type = "const"
)

irf_swap <- irf(
  fit_swap, impulse = variables, response = variables,
  n.ahead = irf_horizon, ortho = TRUE, boot = FALSE
)

irf_first <- irf(
  fit_first, impulse = variables, response = variables,
  n.ahead = irf_horizon, ortho = TRUE, boot = FALSE
)

ordering_irfs <- setNames(
  list(irf_svar$irf, irf_swap$irf, irf_first$irf),
  c(
    paste(variables, collapse = "-"),
    paste(swap_order, collapse = "-"),
    paste(first_order, collapse = "-")
  )
)

ordering_levels <- lapply(ordering_irfs, function(irfs) {
  setNames(
    lapply(variables, function(shock) {
      to_levels(irfs[[shock]][, variables, drop = FALSE])
    }),
    variables
  )
})

# The two FFR-last orderings produce the same one-SD FFR shock
stopifnot(
  max(abs(
    as.matrix(ordering_levels[[1]][[tail(variables, 1L)]][, variables]) -
    as.matrix(ordering_levels[[2]][[tail(variables, 1L)]][, variables])
  )) < 1e-6
)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure-ordering-comparison
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 7.0
#| fig-height: 5.0
#| fig-align: center

plot_irf_matrix(
  model_levels = ordering_levels,
  labels = names(ordering_levels),
  lty = 1:3
)
```

### 18. Reduced-form local projections

```{r}
#| label: reduced-form-lp

# OLS local projections (no instrument and no Cholesky scaling)
x_lp <- as.data.frame(x)

lp_fits <- setNames(
  lapply(variables, function(shock) {
    lp_lin_iv(
      endog_data = x_lp,
      shock = x_lp[, shock, drop = FALSE],
      contemp_data = x_lp[
        , setdiff(variables, shock), drop = FALSE
      ],
      use_twosls = FALSE,
      lags_endog_lin = p_aic,
      trend = 0,
      confint = 1.96,
      use_nw = TRUE,
      hor = irf_horizon + 1L,
      num_cores = 1
    )
  }),
  variables
)

rf_lp_raw <- lapply(lp_fits, function(result) {
  z <- t(result$irf_lin_mean)
  colnames(z) <- variables
  stopifnot(
    nrow(z) == irf_horizon + 1L,
    all(is.finite(z))
  )
  z
})

rf_lp_levels <- lapply(rf_lp_raw, to_levels)
```

### 20. Structural local projections

```{r}
#| label: structural-lp

# Apply exactly the same Cholesky impact matrix P as in Section 15
lp_struct_raw <- setNames(
  lapply(variables, function(shock) {
    matrix(
      NA_real_, nrow = irf_horizon + 1L,
      ncol = length(variables),
      dimnames = list(NULL, variables)
    )
  }),
  variables
)

for (h in seq_len(irf_horizon + 1L)) {
  Psi <- sapply(
    variables,
    function(shock) rf_lp_raw[[shock]][h, variables]
  )

  Theta <- Psi %*% P

  for (j in seq_along(variables)) {
    lp_struct_raw[[j]][h, ] <- Theta[, j]
  }
}

lp_struct_levels <- lapply(lp_struct_raw, to_levels)

# Impact consistency: Psi(0)=I and Theta(0)=P
Psi_0 <- sapply(
  variables,
  function(shock) rf_lp_raw[[shock]][1, variables]
)
Theta_0 <- sapply(
  variables,
  function(shock) lp_struct_raw[[shock]][1, variables]
)


Psi_0
Theta_0
```

### 22. MP1 proxy: common sample and endogenous lag selection

```{r}
#| label: mp1-sample-lag-selection

# Reduced common sample
proxy_dates <- as.Date(
  raw$sasdate,
  "%m/%d/%Y"
)

mp1 <- raw[[proxy_vars[1]]][
  match(Y$Date, proxy_dates)
]

valid <- which(is.finite(mp1))

stopifnot(
  length(valid) > 100L,
  all(diff(valid) == 1L)
)

x_iv <- Y[
  valid, variables, drop = FALSE
]

W_iv <- data.frame(
  mp1[valid],
  x_iv
)

names(W_iv)[1] <- proxy_vars[1]

W_iv <- W_iv[
  , proxy_vars, drop = FALSE
]

stopifnot(
  identical(names(W_iv), proxy_vars)
)

# AIC selects the augmented VAR lag order
proxy_lag_selection <- VARselect(
  W_iv,
  lag.max = p_aic,
  type = "const"
)

p_iv <- as.integer(
  proxy_lag_selection$selection[["AIC(n)"]]
)

p_iv
```

### 23. Common-sample recursive SVAR and MP1-first SVAR


```{r}
#| label: mp1-models-irfs

# Same sample and selected lag order
fit_common <- VAR(
  x_iv,
  p = p_iv,
  type = "const"
)

fit_proxy <- VAR(
  W_iv,
  p = p_iv,
  type = "const"
)

# One-SD FFR-last recursive innovation
irf_common <- irf(
  fit_common,
  impulse = tail(variables, 1L),
  response = variables,
  n.ahead = irf_horizon,
  ortho = TRUE,
  boot = FALSE
)

# One-SD MP1-first orthogonalized innovation
irf_proxy <- irf(
  fit_proxy,
  impulse = proxy_vars[1],
  response = proxy_vars,
  n.ahead = irf_horizon,
  ortho = TRUE,
  boot = FALSE
)

# Common-sample FFR-shock responses
policy_common <- to_levels(
  irf_common$irf[[tail(variables, 1L)]]
)

# MP1-associated macroeconomic responses
policy_proxy <- to_levels(
  irf_proxy$irf[[proxy_vars[1]]][
    , variables, drop = FALSE
  ]
)

# MP1 response to its own innovation
policy_mp1 <- data.frame(
  Horizon = 0:irf_horizon,
  unname(
    irf_proxy$irf[[proxy_vars[1]]][
      , proxy_vars[1]
    ]
  )
)

names(policy_mp1)[2] <- proxy_vars[1]

# Initial FFR impacts (not normalization constants)
ffr_impact_common <- unname(
  irf_common$irf[[tail(variables, 1L)]][
    1, tail(variables, 1L)
  ]
)

ffr_impact_mp1 <- unname(
  irf_proxy$irf[[proxy_vars[1]]][
    1, tail(variables, 1L)
  ]
)
```


### 24. MP1, IP, CPI, and FFR response comparison

```{r}
#| label: figure-mp1-ffr-comparison
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 7.0
#| fig-height: 5.0
#| fig-align: center

responses <- proxy_vars
oldpar <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)

layout(
  matrix(c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 5), nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE),
  heights = c(1, 1, 0.34)
)

par(
  mar = c(1.9, 3.0, 1.35, 0.5),
  oma = c(1.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.2),
  mgp = c(1.5, 0.45, 0),
  cex = 0.8
)

for (response in responses) {
  horizon <- 0:irf_horizon

  if (response == proxy_vars[1]) {
    y_proxy <- policy_mp1[[proxy_vars[1]]]
    bounds <- range(c(y_proxy, 0))
  } else {
    y_common <- policy_common[[response]]
    y_proxy <- policy_proxy[[response]]
    bounds <- range(c(y_common, y_proxy, 0))
  }

  plot(
    horizon, y_proxy, type = "n", ylim = bounds,
    xlab = "", ylab = "", main = "", axes = FALSE
  )
  abline(h = 0, lty = 3, col = "grey60")

  if (response != proxy_vars[1]) {
    lines(horizon, y_common, lty = 1, lwd = 1.2, col = "black")
  }
  lines(horizon, y_proxy, lty = 2, lwd = 1.2, col = "black")

  axis(1, at = seq(0, irf_horizon, by = 12), cex.axis = 0.55)
  axis(2, cex.axis = 0.55)
  mtext(response, side = 3, line = 0.15, font = 2, cex = 0.75)
}

par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
plot.new()
legend(
  x = 0.5, y = 0.74, xjust = 0.5, yjust = 0.5,
  legend = c("Recursive FFR shock", "MP1-associated shock"),
  lty = c(1, 2), lwd = 1.2, col = "black",
  horiz = TRUE, bty = "n", cex = 0.76, seg.len = 3
)
text(0.5, 0.12, "Horizon (months)", cex = 0.75)

layout(1)
par(oldpar)
```

### 25. MP1 relevance and VAR stability diagnostics

```{r}
#| label: mp1-relevance-stability

u_iv <- residuals(fit_proxy)
proxy_corr <- cor(
  u_iv[, proxy_vars[1]],
  u_iv[, tail(variables, 1L)]
)

lag_terms <- grep(
  "\\.l[0-9]+$",
  colnames(fit_proxy$datamat),
  value = TRUE
)

first_stage <- lm(
  reformulate(
    c(proxy_vars[1], lag_terms),
    response = tail(variables, 1L)
  ),
  data = as.data.frame(fit_proxy$datamat)
)

# Conditional coefficient F: descriptive relevance diagnostic
conditional_F <- unname(
  coef(summary(first_stage))[proxy_vars[1], "t value"]^2
)

max_root <- max(roots(fit_proxy, modulus = TRUE))

mp1_diagnostics <- data.frame(
  Diagnostic = c(
    "Proxy observations",
    "Selected augmented-VAR lags",
    "Effective VAR observations",
    "MP1-FFR residual correlation",
    "Conditional MP1 coefficient t-squared",
    "Largest companion-root modulus"
  ),
  Estimate = c(
    nrow(W_iv), p_iv, nrow(u_iv),
    proxy_corr, conditional_F, max_root
  )
)

mp1_diagnostics
```

### 26. MP1 lag-predictability diagnostic

```{r}
#| label: mp1-lag-predictability

idx <- (p_iv + 1L):nrow(W_iv)

macro_lags <- do.call(
  cbind,
  lapply(seq_len(p_iv), function(L) {

    z <- x_iv[
      idx - L, variables, drop = FALSE
    ]

    names(z) <- paste0(
      variables, "_L", L
    )

    rownames(z) <- NULL
    z
  })
)

lag_test_data <- data.frame(
  W_iv[[proxy_vars[1]]][idx],
  macro_lags
)

names(lag_test_data)[1] <- proxy_vars[1]

lag_exog_fit <- lm(
  reformulate(
    names(macro_lags),
    response = proxy_vars[1]
  ),
  data = lag_test_data
)

f_stat <- summary(lag_exog_fit)$fstatistic

lag_exog_F <- unname(
  f_stat["value"]
)

lag_exog_p <- unname(
  pf(
    f_stat["value"],
    f_stat["numdf"],
    f_stat["dendf"],
    lower.tail = FALSE
  )
)

c(
  Lag_predictability_F = lag_exog_F,
  Lag_predictability_p = lag_exog_p
)
```
